name: Credits
bio: Few but good... to save the world from wild scrolling
adventureTitle: The dirty work...someone has to do it

posts.caption: Even if you don't like it...we have to give credit to someone...

comments.author: Marco Vanni
comments.text: But credit to those who apologize?? I never understand your mysterious posts 😂

comments.author: Federico P.
comments.text: It depends on who we're talking about. If it's WHO I THINK, not even dead.

comments.author: Giorgio K.
comments.text: I agree 100%, the truth has to come out sooner or later.

comments.author: Valentina D.
comments.text: Guys, what group are you talking about? Did I miss something??

comments.author: Samuele Rossi

I'm Daniel, creator, developer and mind behind this brilliant project!
